 Belinda Bencic Under Pressure After Opening-Round Win in Ningbo
 She's staying focused: Belinda Bencic has a lot of world ranking points at stake this week
 Keystone
 Belinda Bencic wins her first-round match against Jelena Ostapenko at the WTA 500 tournament in Ningbo. The Latvian retires with the score at 3-6, 1-1.
 Keystone-SDA 
 20.10.2026, 13:12 • 20.10.2026, 13:18 The Swiss player is under a lot of pressure this week: she risks losing all the world ranking points she earned a year ago by winning the tournament in Tokyo. The Olympic champion, currently ranked 14th in the world, must prevent herself from falling out of the top 20.
 Bencic has taken the first step toward that goal. As the tournament progresses, however, she’ll need to step up her game, because things haven’t been going well for her since her loss to Coco Gauff in the round of 16 at Wimbledon. In Ningbo, the situation is made even more difficult by the fact that the Swiss player is in the same quarter of the draw as world No. 1 Yelena Rybakina.
 Her opponent in the second round has not yet been determined.
